meta.purpose: Exercises and self-tests the harness. NOT a measurement of Orison's narrative quality and must never be reported as one. Record a real cassette with --live for that.
meta.warning: The transcript below contains DELIBERATE defects, one per metric. If a run against this cassette reports the transcript suite as clean, the harness is broken, not the engine.
meta.how_it_works: The harness drives real scripted turns through the real PromptBuilder; this cassette stands in for the model. Entries are matched by substring against the assembled prompt, so they key off the character name that PromptBuilder writes into the CHARACTER PROFILE block.

_default_note: SCHEMA defect. Anything not matched above gets a conversational prefix before the JSON object, which is what JsonRepair.gd exists to paper over and what schema-constrained decoding makes impossible (migration plan 2.4). The harness parses strictly, so it is caught. This also means any NEW prompt shape the engine starts emitting will show up as a schema failure, which is a useful canary rather than a nuisance.
_matching_note: Entries are tried IN ORDER and the first substring match wins, so the most specific rules come first. Character-agent rules key off 'Embody the character <name>', which SystemPrompts writes verbatim and which appears in no other prompt. An earlier version matched on the bare character name, which also matched the vault-extraction prompt for that same character and silently replaced their biography with dialogue JSON.
